newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - Jan 2.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - Jan 2.

text.p: These are significant items in the Ivorian press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these items and does not vouch for their accuracy. FRATERNITE MATIN - President Henri Konan Bedie tells Ivorians in New Year message that the economy is on course, that the government will pay companies 100 billion CFA francs in coming days to wipe out its internal debt and that 12 promised public works projects will begin in 1997 LA VOIE - Three La Voie journalists freed from jail following presidential pardon. Abou Drahamane Sangare, Emmanuel Kore and Freedom Neruda were jailed for two years on charges of insulting Bedie in an article. Bedie pardoned them after they had served one year. - France Telecom consortium tipped to win the race to take the majority stake in privatised Ivorian telecommunications company CI-TELCOM LE JOUR - Abou Drahamane Sangare, freed publication director of La Voie, to appear in court again on Thursday in a libel hearing
